items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: had a little group, and Ernie and his brother Marshall

ctx.x: -- had a little group, and Ernie and his brother Marshall, and I forget who he's the drummer in the rhythm section. But when I hired heard Ernie, and he was playing exclusively in a Harmon mute and a cup mute, when I heard him and what he could do with such ease, I decided to get me a band.
